text: Election of the Chair of the Scarborough Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting July 17, 2020 and ending December 31, 2020, or until a successor is appointed.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Jennifer McKelvie as Chair of the Scarborough Community Council for a term of office starting July 17, 2020 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
